android.desc:
Fino is a simple expense tracker, money manager and budget planner for everyday personal finance. Track expenses and income, manage accounts, review monthly spending and understand where your money goes — all in one clean finance tracker.

Whether you want to track daily expenses, organize your income, manage cash and card accounts or get a clearer view of your monthly finances, Fino helps you manage money without unnecessary complexity.

💰 EXPENSE TRACKER & MONEY TRACKER

Record expenses and income in seconds. Choose a category, account and date, add a note when needed and keep your transaction history organized.

Use Fino as your daily money tracker for groceries, shopping, transport, bills, subscriptions, entertainment and other everyday spending. See where your money goes and keep personal finances organized.

Home Screen Widget — Track your balance, income and expenses at a glance. Quickly add expenses or income right from your Home Screen.

📊 MONEY MANAGER & PERSONAL FINANCE

Manage your money from one place. Fino gives you a clear overview of income, expenses and balance so you can understand your financial activity without complicated spreadsheets.

Review your finances by month, compare income and spending and build a clearer picture of your everyday money habits.

💳 MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS

Create separate accounts for cash, cards, savings and other balances. Keep money organized across multiple accounts while still seeing the complete picture.

Transfer money between accounts and keep balances up to date.

📈 SPENDING TRACKER & STATISTICS

Turn everyday transactions into useful spending insights. See expenses by category, compare financial activity and discover where most of your money goes.

Simple statistics and charts make Fino useful as an expense manager, spending tracker and personal finance tracker.

📅 DAILY & MONTHLY EXPENSES

Use the calendar to review transactions by day and follow your financial activity over time.

The monthly overview brings income, expenses and balance together so you always know what happened with your money during the month.

🗂️ CATEGORIES

Organize expenses and income with clear categories. Track food, shopping, transport, bills, entertainment and other spending separately for more useful statistics.

🔒 OFFLINE MONEY TRACKING

Fino works offline. Your financial records stay on your device and you can track money without a constant internet connection.
